home.introTitle: A full GTA 6 map, not a six-region poster
home.introBody: Most “GTA 6 map” pages name Vice City, the Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga — then stop. Map-6 is a free GTA 6 map you pan, zoom, and filter, and it answers a question those pages do not: which real building is this? Over 1,900 spots across Leonida are <realLife>matched to the South Florida address they were modelled on</realLife>, each carrying the community’s own confidence label. Switch official-only to keep just what Rockstar has shown. Copy in-map coordinates, measure distance, and share a deep link to the exact view. We do not host leaked development maps. GTADB community tiles and survey data are credited CC BY 4.0.

faq.a1: Here. Map-6 is a free GTA 6 map of Leonida and Vice City, plus guides that cite official sources. Pan, filter, copy coordinates, measure, and share a deep link. Fan project, not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two.
faq.q2: How do I find collectibles on the GTA 6 map?
faq.a2: Start from /collectibles: it lists every line of the in-game 100% checklist with totals (100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 15 of 18 card sets, 300 of 397 stunts…) and lets you tick them off. GTA 6 has no hidden packages. Use the interactive map and Share to send a spot to friends.
faq.a3: No. Map tiles and many landmarks come from the GTADB / GTA VI Mapping Community under CC BY 4.0, plus Map-6 editorial hubs. We update as the community releases new data. Always verify pins in the retail game after launch.
faq.a4: GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version. Map-6 keeps the map updated as the community survey grows — every change is dated on /updates.
faq.q5: Is Map-6 free? Do you show ads?
faq.a5: Yes, the map and guides are free. We may show clearly labeled Google AdSense units on content pages (not on the fullscreen map/overlay) and disclosed Amazon affiliate links. See About and Privacy for details.

home.storyBody: Rockstar is selling a modern Bonnie-and-Clyde couple in a Florida-shaped state. Lucia Caminos walks out of the Leonida Penitentiary; Jason Duval tried to step away from crime in the Keys. Official trailers and An Extended Look sketch the premise — Map-6 will not invent the last heist or the ending.
home.luciaBody: Official bio: her father taught her to fight; fighting for family put her in prison; luck got her out. She wants the life her mother never got — and she intends to take it. Fan-wiki arcs stay off this card.
home.jasonBody: Rockstar frames him as someone who grew up around criminals and tried another life in the Keys. Meeting Lucia might be the way out — or the way back in. Premise only.
home.featuresTitle: Systems shown in An Extended Look
home.featureDualBody: Switch Lucia and Jason in free roam. Some missions lock a perspective; the other can help as AI.
home.featureWantedBody: Six stars are back, plus icons for what police know — face, guns, car — not only how loud you are.
home.featureLifestyleBody: Food, gym, and sleep change how they look, in a San Andreas spirit. No official stat sheet.
home.relatedReleaseDesc: November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox. PC is a separate, unconfirmed calendar.
home.relatedHistoryDesc: From top-down cities to Los Santos Online to the Leonida bet — why Vice City is back.
home.relatedOnlineDesc: Los Santos keeps running alongside GTA 6. Official Shark Cards via PSN, Xbox, or Steam wallets — not a GTA 6 pack.
home.relatedCardsDesc: Amazon gift-card ASINs to top up the wallets you already use, then buy cash in Rockstar’s store.
